rows.label: tlk43300011_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Word has reached us that the leader of
the Hræsvelgr Mercenaries died.

rows.label: tlk43300011_03_msg0002
rows.name:
He was a legend in his own
right, to build up an elite
squad like that all by himself.

rows.label: tlk43300011_03_msg0003
rows.name:
I remember my father
praising him often.

rows.label: tlk43300011_03_msg0004
rows.name:
I thought the Hræsvelgr Mercenaries
would collapse after their skilled
leader died, but apparently not.

rows.label: tlk43300011_03_msg0005
rows.name:
Looks like the younger members carried
on his will and kept the mercenary
business going.

rows.label: tlk43300011_03_msg0006
rows.name:
But even with the foundation
the previous leader built,
things will be hard from here.

rows.label: tlk43300011_03_msg0007
rows.name:
You'll need to take many jobs,
build experience,
and earn trust.

rows.label: tlk43300011_03_msg0008
rows.name:
If they can keep that up, they'll
steadily grow into a large Merc Group.
